mapper.update: UPDATE reader_book SET import_token=#{token}, import_attempts=import_attempts+1, import_lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{leaseSeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE id=#{bookId} AND deleted=0 AND status=#{importing} AND (import_lease_until IS NULL OR import_lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

UPDATE reader_book SET import_lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{leaseSeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE id=#{bookId} AND import_token=#{token} AND status=#{importing} AND deleted=0 AND import_lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM reader_book WHERE id=#{bookId} AND import_token=#{token} AND status=#{importing} AND deleted=0 AND import_lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE reader_book SET parse_message=#{message}, import_token=NULL, status=CASE WHEN #{terminal} OR import_attempts >= #{maxAttempts} THEN #{failed} ELSE #{importing} END, import_lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{retrySeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE id=#{bookId} AND import_token=#{token} AND status=#{importing} AND deleted=0 AND import_lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
